notes: Summary: Peregrine is a mid-to-large enterprise (global SaaS for mid-market merchants) evaluating a RAG pipeline to power their support assistant and automated ticket deflection.
Primary goals: reduce live agent load by 30% through high-precision retrieval + reranking; keep initial reply latency <200ms for hot queries; maintain top-5 relevance quality for suggested answers.
Scale/Index: plan to index ~12M unique knowledge objects (KB articles + past tickets + product docs). Initial embed dims 1024; experimenting with 1536 for higher recall in reranker step.
Throughput & latency targets: 800 qps peak across global regions (NA + EU); avg P95 retrieval+rerank end-to-end <= 300ms, target P50 ~120ms for cached hits.
Cost sensitivity: want cost-per-query (retrieve+rerank) <= $0.01 in production. Open to dedicated capacity or on-prem for predictable unit economics.

Architecture being tested in POC: hybrid retrieval (approx nearest neighbors with ANN store) + lightweight bi-encoder for first-pass + 7B cross-encoder reranker for top-5 re-scoring; KV caching for hot document sets.
Quality metrics for POC: precision@5 >= 0.78, MRR@5 >= 0.42, rollback threshold if reranker increases latencies beyond 350ms.
Security/compliance notes: must support SSO/SAML for internal users, customer data redaction pipeline before indexing, audit logs retained 1 year, optional EU-only residency for sensitive accounts.
Quote from CTO (call 2026-02-14): "If the first suggested reply takes >200ms we lose conversational flow — that's our hard requirement."
